name: 诅咒增幅
description: 复制对方手牌里所有的诅咒。
targetText: 对方手牌里的所有诅咒
code: function executeSkill(context) { var caster = context.piece; var opponent = battle.players.find(function(player) { return player.playerId !== caster.ownerPlayerId; }); if (!opponent || !opponent.hand) return { success: false, message: '对手没有手牌' }; var curses = opponent.hand.filter(function(card) { return (card.name && card.name.indexOf('诅咒') >= 0) || (card.cardId && card.cardId.indexOf('rafaam-curse') === 0); }); if (!curses.length) return { success: false, message: '对手手牌中没有诅咒' }; if (!battle.customCards) battle.customCards = {}; for (var i = 0; i < curses.length; i++) { var card = curses[i]; var cardId = card.cardId; var custom = battle.customCards[cardId]; if (custom) { var copyId = 'rafaam-curse-copy-' + Date.now() + '-' + i; var copy = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(custom)); copy.id = copyId; battle.customCards[copyId] = copy; cardId = copyId; } addCardToHand(cardId, caster.ownerPlayerId); } return { success: true, message: caster.name + '复制了对方手牌中的' + curses.length + '张诅咒' }; }
previewCode: function calculatePreview() { return { description: '复制对方手牌里的所有诅咒。', expectedValues: {} }; }
